turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have twenty minutes, Hale, and I'd like to know why my son's grade went to a zero before anyone called me.
I don't think this is productive.
"I don't think this is productive." I'm writing that down. Who decided to enter the zero, Hale, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
I'm going to go. I have a class in ten minutes.

Then you have ten minutes, Hale, and you'll spend them on my question. Who entered the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen first? If you walk out without answering, I'm going to the principal's office next.
Email the principal if you want. I'm done here.

I won't be emailing, Hale. I'll be standing in the principal's office with your own school's procedure 4.2 in my hand, and nobody called me before that mark went in. Withdraw the zero in writing, right now, and you can go to your class.
